authority: T0 exact fixed-lattice finite-volume route-split theorem: the ST8/Q3LOCK Hamiltonians define one phase-independent local polynomial CCR derivation before any state is selected; a sharp source-uniform coercive shift gives a source- and volume-uniform weighted first-local-energy cone; any Fourier--Stieltjes cutoff that agrees with the exact quartic on a radius-R ball has second moment at least 3(g+3lambda)R^2, so the audited bounded-Weyl theorem cannot furnish a cutoff-uniform operator-norm Lieb--Robinson speed. Higher weighted-energy moments, thermodynamic Cauchy convergence, exponentiation to a common alpha, and KMS identification remain open

common_local_derivation.definition: delta_h(A)=(i/hbar)[H_Lambda(h),A] once Lambda contains the one-neighbourhood of supp(A)

derived_bounds: sum_(x in X)|q_x|^2<=epsilon K+|X|/(4 epsilon gamma)

weighted_first_local_energy.weight_contract: E_f=sum_x f_x e_x with f_x>0 and exp(-mu)<=f_x/f_y<=exp(mu) on adjacent sites
weighted_first_local_energy.three_dimensional_growth_bound: tau_t^Lambda(E_f)<=exp[6 sqrt(c/(2chi))(exp(mu)-1)|t|] E_f as a finite-volume transported quadratic-form inequality

fourier_cutoff_obstruction.contract: V_R(q)=integral exp(i k.q) mu_R(dk), kappa_R=integral |k|^2 |mu_R|(dk), and V_R=W4 on |q|<=R
fourier_cutoff_obstruction.consequence: The speed delivered by arXiv:0909.2249 Theorem 4.2 through its global Fourier second moment diverges at least quadratically with R
fourier_cutoff_obstruction.scope: This refutes only cutoff-uniform operator-norm LR control through that theorem and moment. It does not refute exact common dynamics or an energy-weighted locality proof.

basic_resolvent_core_obstruction.commutator: [W4(Q),R_z]=-i hbar R_z(D_a W4)(Q)R_z on Schwartz space
basic_resolvent_core_obstruction.preserving_displacement: Q maps to Q+s a and P maps to P-s b, leaving a.P+b.Q invariant
basic_resolvent_core_obstruction.cubic_growth: D_a W4(Q+s a)=4s^3 W4(a)+O(s^2), with W4(a)>0
basic_resolvent_core_obstruction.bounded_input_test: For normalized xi in C_c^infty with q-support in B_r0, psi_s=U_s(L-z)xi and phi_s=U_s(L-conj(z))xi have s-independent norms and give <phi_s,R_z(D_a W4)(Q)R_z psi_s>=4W4(a)s^3+O(s^2)
basic_resolvent_core_obstruction.cutoff_norm_lower_bound: If V_R=W4 on B_R, the same identity holds for 0<=s<=(R-r0)/|a|; choosing s=(R-r0)/(2|a|) gives ||R_z(D_a V_R)(Q)R_z||>=c_xi,z,a R^3 for all large R
basic_resolvent_core_obstruction.consequence: The sandwiched commutator is unbounded for the exact quartic, and cutoffs agreeing on expanding balls have basic-resolvent commutator norms growing at least cubically
basic_resolvent_core_obstruction.scope: This refutes the standard unweighted basic-resolvent generator-core estimate, not finite-time resolvent-algebra invariance by another argument or an energy-damped core.
